title: Just came across this sub and wanted to share one of my most common recurring dreams
content: The context of why I’m at this hotel is always somewhat unclear, but sometimes I’m with family on vacation with aunts, uncles, cousins, grandparents in other rooms (one time I saw my grandma dead in an armchair behind a wooden room divider) The hotel has yellow walls most of the time or off white, and I’m always heading somewhere whether it’s a way out or to an event at the parlor/convention center. Nothing feels off or scary until I’m off and alone. Sometimes I go into rooms where I know a crime took place but there’s no gore or people or even evidence, I just feel it. It almost feels like I can feel the monsterous auras of bad people who occupied the rooms. Sometimes I have to crawl through small doors to get out of dead ends, and sometimes I have to crawl through spaces inside of rooms to get anywhere new. Things vary from dream to dream but this next part is always occurs. I always have to pass a very certain hallway. The hallway gives me the most violent sense of impending doom and I vibrate when walking near the hall. Once I get close enough to see all the rooms down the hall everything starts flashing red and I feel as if I can’t continue or else I’ll get dragged into a specific room that I know this feeling of dread and horror is coming from. Anyone else have any hotel experiences like this?
